hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/sdk/go1.26.1/bin:$PATH"; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f"; d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && go vet .) || exit 2; fixes=$(cd "$d" && go fix -diff . 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$fixes" ]; then printf 'go fix modernization opportunities:\n%s\n' "$fixes" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
